content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm looking for a way to disable the cursor on the [product_name] display panel, as I only want to use the function keys. Is there a solution for this? Any suggestions would be appreciated. Thank you.

Hi, I'm curious why you'd like to turn off the cursor buttons. If your goal is to prevent operators from changing a certain value, you can use the 'Protect' option in the message settings. However, note that it's still possible to adjust values via the parameter menu. To block this as well, apply the protect setting at the function block. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to limit operator controls to only function keys on a [product_name] panel by disabling the cursor buttons. Another user suggests using protective features, which restricts value changes but does not fully meet the request to deactivate cursor functionality. This indicates an unmet usability need for more customizable operator controls.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to deactivate or hide the cursor buttons on the [product_name] panel, allowing only the function keys to be used.
